data.gender_notes: Estrin is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'astēr', meaning 'star'. In Greek mythology, Estrin was a name given to several stars and celestial bodies. It is also found in the New Testament as the name of a disciple of Jesus. The name Estrin carries the meaning “Star, Resplendent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Estrin usually hope their child will grow to embody star, resplendent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Estrin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Εστρίν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εστρίν έχει σχέση με την ελληνική λέξη για 'αστήρ' (αστρ), που σημαίνει 'star'. Στην πνευματική διάσταση, το όνομα συνδέεται με την ελπίδα και τη φωτεινότητα, συμβολίζοντας ένα οδηγό φως για εκείνους γύρω από το άτομο με αυτό το όνομα.

in_latin.name: Estrin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Estrin derivationem habet ab Hebraeo, quod significat 'stella' vel 'luminaria'. In ecclesia primitiva, nomina stellarum et luminis saepe erant symbola spei et salutis. Hoc nomen potest denotare personam quae aliis viam demonstrat et spem affert.

in_english.name: Estrin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Estrin originates from Hebrew roots, meaning 'shining star' or 'radiant light'. It is associated with the biblical concept of light in darkness, symbolizing hope, guidance, and spiritual illumination. Historically, names related to stars and light were significant in Christian tradition, representing figures who guide and inspire others. The name Estrin may signify a person of hope, positivity, and spiritual leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Estrin holds a rich cultural significance, as it has been used throughout history as a name for stars and celestial bodies. This legacy can be traced back to ancient Greece, where the word 'astēr' means 'star'. The use of Estrin as a personal name conveys a mystical and spiritual connection with the vastness and beauty of the universe. In Christian tradition, Estrin is also associated with St. Astrid of Belgium, a modern saint who was known for her grace, generosity, and unwavering faith.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Estrin carries deep meaning as a reminder of the divine and celestial origins of all living beings. In the Bible, Estrin is mentioned as the name of a disciple of Jesus, emphasizing the connection between the spiritual realm and our earthly existence.
